payload.headline: The Planner successfully used XML patching to inject cached numeric values into formula cells while maintaining workbook integrity and complex cell references.
payload.evidence: The Planner's strategy of using XML patching to inject cached numeric values into formula cells is highly effective for tasks requiring both formula preservation and immediate data availability. Precise handling of the http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main namespace during lxml patching is critical; failure to do so results in corrupt workbooks. Using mixed references (e.g., $D12 and H$10) in the INDEX/MATCH lookup allowed for programmatic population of the grid while maintaining Excel's drag-and-fill logic.
payload.mediator_reasoning: The task was successful, but the specific implementation details regarding XML patching (the most complex part of the instructions) provide a reusable pattern for similar high-fidelity Excel manipulation tasks.
